mechanism: Hydroxychloroquine may prolong QT interval and has potential for cardiac arrhythmias; sacubitril's hemodynamic effects and ACE inhibitor component (valsartan) may compound cardiovascular risk, particularly in patients with baseline conduction abnormalities.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval at baseline and during therapy; ensure adequate electrolyte levels (K+, Mg2+); consider alternative antimalarial if possible; assess for symptoms of arrhythmia or heart failure decompensation.
